req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. FastAPI enforces path parameter type coercion; a non-integer value causes a 422 Unprocessable Entity before the route handler executes. Tests cover: (1) positive — a valid integer squad number returns 200 (EP, proves the happy path and that the validator does not over-reject); (2) negative — a purely alphabetic string returns 422 (NEG, core requirement); (3) boundary — a float string like '7.5' returns 422 (BVA, numeric-looking but not integer); (4) negative — a special-character string returns 422 (NEG, extended equivalence class); (5) negative — a mixed alphanumeric string returns 422 (NEG, non-integer equivalence class — fixed from EP to NEG to satisfy rule that negative kind must not use EP heuristic); (6) boundary — squad number '1' (integer lower boundary) returns 200 (BVA); (7) boundary — empty segment returns not-200 (BVA); (8) negative — whitespace segment returns 422 (NEG); (9) negative — literal string 'None' returns 422 (DT). Each test asserts the exact status code to catch comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_get_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
trace: R-PLAYER-037: valid integer must NOT be rejected; confirms the 422 guard does not over-fire
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
body = r.json()
assert body['squadNumber'] == 10, f'Expected squadNumber=10, got {body.get("squadNumber")}'
